subject: FinCorp deployment path & networking recap — next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@fincorphq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinCorp deployment path & networking recap — next steps

Hi Daniel / Alexa — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap and specific asks so we can lock the hosting posture for the PoC and prepare a Mutual Action Plan (attached).

Summary (what we heard)
- Preferred: Private VPC (customer-managed account) to ensure traffic never transits public endpoints.
- Constraint: Corporate firewall / egress restrictions mean PrivateLink may be favored over peering.
- Key asks from your side: IP allowlist, cert/KMS integration, SOC2 evidence, and estimated provisioning lead time.

Please confirm the answers to the numbered items below so we can finalize the MAP and scope:
1) PrivateLink vs VPC peering: do you have a hard requirement for PrivateLink (explicitly blocked peering) or is peering acceptable if we tunnel to a secure subnet?
2) Egress & allowlist: can you provide CIDR(s) or the IP ranges (staging + prod) you can allow? If you need us to NAT egress through your managed IPs, state that here.
3) Certificate/KMS: will you expect us to integrate with your KMS (customer-managed keys) or use Redwood-managed keys?
4) SOC2 / compliance artifacts: which artifacts do you need up front vs during procurement?
5) Timeline: target window to begin network provisioning? Any blackout dates?

Attachments: FinCorp-MAP-20260925.pdf (draft MAP), fincorp-network-sketch.png (hand-drawn topology from call).

Next steps (what we propose)
- You provide answers to Q1–Q4 above and the IP ranges by end of next week.
- We schedule a 30–45m tech deep-dive with NetOps (Ben) to confirm routing and test connectivity.
- We’ll include a short note on Dedicated capacity vs Hosted pricing impact for comparison.

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally to line up Ben for the deep-dive once we have the ranges.

Best,
Soojin

From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@fincorphq.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alexa Ruiz <alexa.ruiz@fincorphq.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinCorp deployment path & networking recap — next steps

Soojin — thanks for the recap and the draft MAP. Quick answers inline below.

1) PrivateLink vs peering: PrivateLink is our preference because our security team restricts inbound peering from external vendors to our VPCs. So yes, please assume PrivateLink is required for prod. For PoC we can open a temporary peering if it speeds things up, but that requires approval from SecOps and will take longer.
2) IP allowlist: staging will be a small CIDR we control — we can allow 3 IPs for your staging load tester initially. For prod we will allow a /28 from our perimeter NAT. I’ll send exact ranges by EOW.
3) KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys (AWS KMS). We need to ensure Redwood can perform envelope encryption with our key policy; if that’s not possible we’ll need a security exception.
4) SOC2: we need the SOC2 Type II report and a short architecture diagram describing data flow (no PII). The SOC2 can be provided during procurement but the architecture note helps our legal team.
5) Timeline: target to start provisioning week of Oct 11. No blackouts next two weeks.

Other notes: pricing sensitivity — can you include a Delta between Hosted API and Dedicated monthly commit in the MAP? Also want a rough estimate if Private VPC adds >20% provisioning lead time vs Dedicated.

I’ll follow up with exact IP ranges in a separate email.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Cho | Head of Platform Engineering | FinCorp
daniel.cho@fincorphq.com | +1 212-555-1290

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FinCorp deployment path & networking recap — next steps

Folks — forwarding FinCorp's responses. TL;DR: PrivateLink required for prod, will provide CIDRs by EOW, want CMK (AWS KMS), SOC2 during procurement, start provisioning w/c Oct 11.

Action items I propose:
- Ben: can you size a short NetOps deep-dive (30–45m) to validate PrivateLink flow and what we need on our side (staging IPs, NAT behavior, required subnets)? Please prepare a short checklist: VIPs we will present, TLS/SNI expectations, and any inbound NAT requirements.
- Ben & Marissa: please add a short line in the MAP that shows the cost delta: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (order-of-magnitude for monthly baseline + one-time setup). Daniel explicitly asked for a delta and an estimate of additional provisioning lead time for Private VPC.
- Marissa: can you draft the quick SOC2 + architecture blurb we can hand to legal during procurement? Keep it high level and highlight that no PII is stored.

I attached the draft MAP and the network sketch. If we can get the NetOps checklist and the delta by Tue (Sep 29), I’ll send an updated MAP and propose a tech deep-dive for Wed/Thu next week (Oct 6/7).

Thanks — I’ll send calendar invites when Ben confirms availability.

Best,
Soojin
